tab_reorder_latency.description: Reorder a tab from near the start to the end and back as tab count grows.

paste_insert_phase.description: Diagnostic insertion phase for a 128 MiB mixed UTF-8 paste, excluding fixture setup and metadata refresh.

paste_metadata_phase.description: Diagnostic synchronous metadata-refresh phase after a 128 MiB mixed UTF-8 paste.

paste_stress_latency.description: Insert and synchronously refresh metadata for a 128 MiB mixed UTF-8 paste.

snapshot_shared_edit_latency.description: Edit a document with 16 MiB of inserted text while an immutable worker snapshot remains alive.

snapshot_shared_fragmented_edit_latency.description: Edit a 20,000-fragment document while an immutable worker snapshot remains alive.

dense_line_lookup_latency.description: Resolve 1,024 distributed lines in 4 MiB of dense short lines.

reverse_character_walk_latency.description: Walk backward through 8 Ki Unicode scalar values in one large piece.

fragmented_tree_edit_latency.description: Insert into a live tree after 20,000 fragmenting edits.

large_paste_undo_latency.description: Undo a recorded 16 MiB mixed UTF-8 paste.

session_restore_latency.description: Restore the startup-visible tab from a persisted 10,000-tab session.

session_restore_background_completion.description: Diagnostic completion latency for hydrating a persisted 10,000-tab session after startup-visible restore.

session_persist_latency.description: Steady-state background persistence latency for an unchanged 10,000-tab session; unchanged snapshots must not be rewritten.
